ev.q: None of the ventilation strategies examined was reported by >51% of school districts.
High-poverty school districts more frequently reported each of the four ventilation improvements in most schools than did low- and mid-poverty school districts
Among the four ventilation improvements examined, maintaining continuous airflow in classrooms was reported by just over one half (50.7%) of school districts
one third (33.9%) reported having HVAC system improvements in progress or completed
Descriptive analyses summarizing responses to ventilation questions are presented for the overall sample and stratified by U.S. Census Bureau region
CDC examined reported ventilation improvement strategies among U.S. K–12 public school districts using telephone survey data collected during August–December 2022
repeatedly surveyed school district office staff members by telephone

methods_quotes.q: Descriptive analyses summarizing responses to ventilation questions are presented for the overall sample and stratified by U.S. Census Bureau region
Poverty levels were based on the 2021 SAIPE for school-aged children living in poverty
Responses were grouped into three categories
The most recent response from school districts was included for analysis.
Analyses were conducted using R (version 1.4.1106; R Foundation).
Only responses from October 26, 2022, onward were included in the analysis.
